title: nirs4all importance profile envelope v1
description: Host-built envelope around one global importance profile of a fitted model (nirs4all-methods ABI 2.24 model-intrinsic importances, or a mean local gradient) plus host metadata. Sibling of nirs4all.explanation.v1 (local, per-row attributions). values[j] belongs to axis.values[j]. A model_input profile is drawn on the raw spectral axis only when every preprocessing step is column aligned; a raw_input profile is exact (exactness exact) only when every preprocessing step is affine, otherwise it is a mean of local gradients (exactness local_mean). The two are never silently mixed. Consumers ignore unknown keys.

kind.description: regression_coefficients: B[:, output] of predict(X) = X B + b (n4m_estimator_affine_coefficients_v1, or n4m_role_pipeline_input_affine_coefficients_v1 in raw_input space); standardized_coefficients: B[j, output] * sd_j (ddof 1) of the rows used; vip: variable importance in projection (all outputs); selectivity_ratio: target-projection selectivity ratio of the output (Rajalahti et al. 2009); x_weights / x_loadings: column `component` of W / P; mean_local_gradient: mean over rows of the local raw-space gradients (gradient explainer).

space.description: model_input: the features the model consumes after preprocessing; raw_input: the raw spectral input of the complete fitted pipeline.

exactness.description: exact: an exact property of the fitted model (raw_input only through affine preprocessing, B_raw = A' B); local_mean: a mean of local gradients over the rows used.

signed.description: True when the sign is meaningful (coefficients, weights, loadings, gradients); false for VIP and the selectivity ratio.

component.description: Latent component index (0-based) for x_weights and x_loadings; null otherwise.

unit.description: Axis unit as recorded by the host (for example nm or cm-1); null when unknown. Never invented.

kind.description: wavelength / wavenumber / feature_index on the raw axis; model_feature for model-input features that are not column aligned with the raw axis.

values.description: Profile values, one per axis coordinate (finite JSON numbers). The native selectivity ratio is +Infinity for an exactly reconstructed column; JSON cannot carry it, so the host records its replacement policy in settings.

rows.description: Rows used (VIP, selectivity ratio, standardization, gradients): count and the host's description of their source (for example train partition, preprocessed); null when the kind uses no rows.

steps.description: Method ids of the preprocessing steps, in order.

affine.description: Every step declares the affine-transform trait (N4M_CAP_AFFINE_TRANSFORM) or is a sample filter.

column_aligned.description: Every step keeps output column j at the spectral position of input column j (N4M_CAP_COLUMN_ALIGNED with equal widths).

settings.description: Kind settings (for example gradient_step, ddof, reference).
